faq.label: ENTERPRISE FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Partnering with Leapsofts
faq.subtitle: Clear answers regarding our agile pod model, technical compliance, source code ownership, and delivery methodology.

items.question: What makes Leapsofts different from traditional software outsourcing firms?
items.answer: Unlike conventional outsourcing vendors who assign junior developers or fragmented freelancers, Leapsofts operates using dedicated Agile Pods. Each pod consists of hand-picked senior architects, engineers, DevOps leads, and QA specialists who work directly inside your communication channels (Slack/Teams). We focus on zero-trust security, zero technical debt, and 100% transparent code delivery.

items.question: Where are Leapsofts' primary headquarters and engineering delivery hubs located?
items.answer: Our international regional headquarters is located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with strategic North American delivery operations in the United States and specialized cloud AI engineering hubs in Europe. This multi-region footprint ensures continuous timezone coverage and synchronous communication for global clients.

items.question: Who retains ownership of the Intellectual Property (IP) and source code?
items.answer: You retain 100% exclusive ownership of all source code, IP rights, architecture blueprints, database schemas, and deployment pipelines. Code is pushed directly to your private GitHub/GitLab repositories throughout every sprint with complete visibility.

items.question: What security and regulatory compliance standards do your teams adhere to?
items.answer: Security is integrated into our software development lifecycle from Day 1. We design systems to comply with ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA (for healthcare platforms), PCI-DSS (for financial services), and GDPR (for data protection).

items.question: How fast can Leapsofts launch a custom enterprise MVP or platform?
items.answer: By leveraging our AI-augmented engineering workflows, modular microservice blueprints, and automated CI/CD pipelines, we typically deliver production-grade custom MVPs in 3 to 5 months without sacrificing architectural integrity or security.

items.question: Can your software engineering teams integrate with our existing internal team?
items.answer: Yes. We support both full product ownership (building solutions end-to-end) and team augmentation (integrating specialized software pods into your existing engineering leadership, Jira pipelines, and CI/CD environments).

items.question: How does Leapsofts handle project management and daily communication?
items.answer: We maintain 100% operational transparency. Clients have direct daily communication with senior solution architects and pod leads via dedicated Slack channels, weekly sprint demos, real-time Jira/Linear task tracking, and staging build previews.

items.question: What post-launch maintenance and support services do you offer?
items.answer: We provide long-term continuous enhancement, SLA-backed 24/7 production monitoring, cloud infrastructure optimization, security patch updates, and feature scaling partnerships after launch.
